settings.label: Beacon: {matchName, enterDbm, exitDbm, enterDwellMs, exitDwellMs, silenceMs}
settings.help:
A Bluetooth beacon that marks this place, with how strong its signal must be to count as here.
Set it in Settings, Places and people, where you can pick a beacon nearby.

settings.label: Wi-Fi: {ssids, bssids, required}
settings.help:
The Wi-Fi networks that mean you are at this place.
Set them in Settings, Places and people, which offers the network you are on now.

settings.label: Zone id this place answers to
settings.help: The hub zone this place follows, so the hub can say who is here. Leave it empty without a hub.
